tools.name: animation.animator add_layer
tools.description: Add a layer to an AnimatorController.

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Layer name.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Layer weight (default 1).

parameters.name: blendingMode
parameters.description: Blending mode: Override | Additive (default Override).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the layer.

tools.name: animation.animator add_parameter
tools.description: Add a parameter (Float | Int | Bool | Trigger) to an AnimatorController. A duplicate name returns code 'duplicate_parameter'.

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Parameter name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Parameter type: Float | Int | Bool | Trigger.

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: Default value for Float/Int/Bool (ignored for Trigger).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the parameter.

tools.name: animation.animator add_state
tools.description: Add a state to a layer, optionally with a motion (AnimationClip or BlendTree) and as the layer default. A layer name with no match returns code 'layer_not_found'.

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Layer index (int) or name (string). Default 0 (Base Layer).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: State name.

parameters.name: motion
parameters.description: Optional AnimationClip or BlendTree asset to assign as the state's motion.

parameters.name: isDefault
parameters.description: If true, set this state as the layer's default state.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Optional [x, y] node position in the graph (cosmetic).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the state.

tools.name: animation.animator add_transition
tools.description: Add a transition between two states (or from AnyState/Entry, to Exit) on a layer, with optional conditions. Validates that the states exist and each condition's parameter exists and its mode matches the parameter type.

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Layer index (int) or name (string). Default 0 (Base Layer).

parameters.name: fromState
parameters.description: Source state name, or the special "AnyState" / "Entry".

parameters.name: toState
parameters.description: Destination state name, or the special "Exit".

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Optional conditions: [{ parameter, mode: "If"|"IfNot"|"Greater"|"Less"|"Equals"|"NotEqual", threshold? }].

parameters.name: hasExitTime
parameters.description: If true, the transition uses exit time (default false).

parameters.name: exitTime
parameters.description: Normalized exit time (0..1) when hasExitTime is set.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Transition duration in seconds (default 0.25).

parameters.name: hasFixedDuration
parameters.description: If true, duration is in seconds; otherwise normalized (default true).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate everything (states, parameters, mode/type) without writing the transition.

tools.name: animation.animator create_controller
tools.description: Create an .controller AnimatorController asset (with a default Base Layer) under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path ending in .controller, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: animation.animator get_controller
tools.description: Read an AnimatorController's full structure: parameters, layers, states (with motion / default), and transitions (with conditions).

parameters.name: controller
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimatorController to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: animation.clip create
tools.description: Create an empty .anim AnimationClip asset under the authoring root, with an optional frame rate and loop flag.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path ending in .anim, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: frameRate
parameters.description: Sampling frame rate of the clip (default 60).

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: If true, set the clip's loop-time flag in its AnimationClipSettings (default false).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: animation.clip get
tools.description: Read an AnimationClip's metadata and all float curve bindings (optionally with keyframes).

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to read (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: includeKeys
parameters.description: If true, include each binding's keyframes (default false).

tools.name: animation.clip remove_curve
tools.description: Remove a float curve binding from an AnimationClip (SetEditorCurve(clip, binding, null)). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the binding lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type of the binding to remove, e.g. "Transform". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Curve property name to remove, e.g. "m_LocalPosition.x".

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually remove the binding (destructive guard).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report the binding that would be removed without removing it.

tools.name: animation.clip set_curve
tools.description: Add or replace a single float curve binding on an AnimationClip (via AnimationUtility.SetEditorCurve). Replacing an existing binding overwrites it rather than duplicating.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Reference to the AnimationClip to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: GameObject path relative to the animated root the property lives on. Empty string (default) targets the root.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type the property lives on, e.g. "Transform", "UnityEngine.Light". Resolved via the component TypeResolver.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Curve property name, e.g. "m_LocalPosition.x", "m_LocalScale.y", "localEulerAnglesRaw.z".

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Keyframes: [{ time, value, inTangent?, outTangent?, weightedMode?: "None"|"In"|"Out"|"Both" }]. Omitted tangents default to 0 (flat); this is NOT Unity's Auto tangent mode.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate type/property/keys without writing the curve.

tools.name: animation.timeline add_clip
tools.description: Add a clip to a named track on a TimelineAsset. For Animation tracks pass an AnimationClip asset; for Audio tracks an AudioClip. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description: Reference to the TimelineAsset to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Target track name.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Clip start time in seconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Clip duration in seconds.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Source asset: for Animation tracks an AnimationClip; for Audio tracks an AudioClip. Required for those track types.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the clip.

tools.name: animation.timeline add_track
tools.description: Add a track (Animation | Audio | Activation | Control | Playable | Signal | Marker) to a TimelineAsset, optionally nested under a parent group/track. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description: Reference to the TimelineAsset to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: trackType
parameters.description: Track type: Animation | Audio | Activation | Control | Playable | Signal | Marker.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional track display name.

parameters.name: parentTrack
parameters.description: Optional name of an existing group/track to nest the new track under.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs without writing the track.

tools.name: animation.timeline create
tools.description: Create a .playable TimelineAsset under the authoring root (optional frame rate). Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path ending in .playable, relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: frameRate
parameters.description: Timeline frame rate (default 60).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: animation.timeline get
tools.description: Read a TimelineAsset's structure: frame rate, duration, and its tracks with their clips. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

parameters.name: timeline
parameters.description: Reference to the TimelineAsset to read (path / guid / globalId).

tools.name: asset copy
tools.description: Copy an asset to a new path under the authoring root. The copy gets a fresh GUID.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to copy (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the destination path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be copied without writing anything.

tools.name: asset create
tools.description: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension (e.g. Data/Config.asset or Materials/Wall.mat). The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Fully-qualified or short type name to instantiate (e.g. UnityEngine.Material, MyGame.GameConfig). Must derive from UnityEngine.Object and be creatable.

parameters.name: shader
parameters.description: Material-only (ignored otherwise): shader name to assign (e.g. Standard, "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit"). When omitted, defaults to "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit" if a Scriptable Render Pipeline is active, otherwise the built-in "Standard" shader (falling back to "Standard" if URP/Lit is unavailable).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path. Ignored when the path is empty.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

tools.name: asset create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder under the authoring root (creates intermediate folders).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder path relative to the authoring root (default Assets/); the Assets/ prefix is optional. e.g. Gameplay/Enemies or Assets/Gameplay/Enemies

tools.name: asset delete
tools.description: Delete an asset from the project. Destructive: requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to delete (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to actually delete. Without it the command refuses (destructive guard).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, report the asset that would be deleted without deleting it.

tools.name: asset find
tools.description: Find assets by type and/or name and/or label, returning their path, GUID and type. At least one filter is required.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type name to filter by (e.g. Material, GameObject, ScriptableObject, MyGame.GameConfig). Resolved to a System.Type and matched against each asset's actual main type.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name substring to filter by (AssetDatabase name filter).

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Asset label to filter by (AssetDatabase 'l:' filter).

parameters.name: search_in
parameters.description: Folder to scope the search to, relative to the authoring root (default: the authoring root).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 200).

tools.name: asset get_import_settings
tools.description: Read an asset's import settings, structured by importer type (texture/model/audio), including the default-platform fields and (for textures/audio) one platform override block.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset whose importer to read (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform whose override to read: Default | Standalone | iOS | Android | WebGL | tvOS. Defaults to Default.

tools.name: asset import
tools.description: Import an external file (e.g. a texture, model, audio clip) into the project by copying it to a path under the authoring root, then importing it.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to the external file to import.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the destination path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be imported without writing anything.

tools.name: asset move
tools.description: Move (or rename via a new path) an asset to a new location under the authoring root. Preserves the asset's GUID.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to move (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate the move (via AssetDatabase.ValidateMoveAsset) without performing it.

tools.name: asset read_text
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file under the authoring root and return its contents.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Text file path relative to the authoring root. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Reject files larger than this many bytes (default 1048576 = 1 MiB) to avoid huge payloads.

tools.name: asset rename
tools.description: Rename an asset in place (keeps it in the same folder, keeps its GUID).

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset to rename (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: New file name WITHOUT a folder path. The extension is preserved if omitted.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate the rename without performing it.

tools.name: asset set_import_settings
tools.description: Set import settings on an asset's AssetImporter (default platform top-level properties, or a texture/audio per-platform override) and re-import it.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Reference to the asset whose importer to edit (path / guid / globalId).

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: JSON object of importer property/field names to values, e.g. {"isReadable": true, "textureType": "NormalMap"}. For platform != Default on a texture/audio importer, keys map onto the platform-settings struct (e.g. maxTextureSize, format, compressionFormat, quality, and overridden).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Target platform: Default | Standalone | iOS | Android | WebGL | tvOS. Defaults to Default (top-level importer properties). A real platform writes a per-platform override (textures/audio only).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate which settings would apply (and which are unknown) without writing or re-importing.

tools.name: asset write_text
tools.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Text file path relative to the authoring root, including extension. The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: The full text content to write (replaces the file).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing file at the path.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be written without writing anything.

tools.name: authoring get_root
tools.description: Get the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against.

tools.name: authoring set_root
tools.description: Set the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against and are confined to. Use 'Assets' for full project access.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Project-relative folder under Assets/, e.g. Assets/AgentWork. Use 'Assets' to allow the whole project.

tools.name: build create_profile
tools.description: Create a Build Profile asset for a platform (Unity 6 only). Call build list_platforms first to get a platform id. Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Profile name (e.g. "Meta Quest"). A Build Profile is named after its file, so this is also the file name and the name build run --profileName matches.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform id, display name ("Meta Quest") or BuildTarget name ("Android"). See build list_platforms.

parameters.name: subtarget
parameters.description: Standalone only: Player | Server. Disambiguates desktop platforms; ignored elsewhere.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder to create the profile in. Defaults to Assets/Settings/Build Profiles.

parameters.name: activate
parameters.description: Make the new profile the active Build Profile after creating it.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing profile of the same name in the folder.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate the name, platform and folder and report what would be created, without writing anything.

tools.name: build get_settings
tools.description: Read the current build configuration from EditorUserBuildSettings / EditorBuildSettings.

tools.name: build list_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms a Build Profile can target, with their platform id (Unity 6 only). Lists only platforms whose build support is installed; pass showAll=true for every known platform.

parameters.name: showAll
parameters.description: Include platforms whose build support module is not installed.

tools.name: build list_profiles
tools.description: List Build Profile assets in the project (Unity 6 only). Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

tools.name: build run
tools.description: Trigger an async Player build and report the full BuildReport. Returns immediately (queued); poll build status until status is 'completed'. DetailedBuildReport is included by default unless 'options' is supplied. Use dry_run to validate without building.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: BuildTarget name (e.g. StandaloneWindows64). Defaults to the active target. Must be installed.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Output path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to the last/auto path.

parameters.name: profileName
parameters.description: Build Profile name to activate before building (Unity 6 only; ignored otherwise).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: BuildOptions names. Omit to get just DetailedBuildReport; supplying any disables that default.

parameters.name: scenes
parameters.description: Scene asset paths to build (e.g. Assets/Scenes/Main.unity). Defaults to EditorBuildSettings.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Acknowledge and run the build; without it the call is refused. Use dry_run to validate only.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate target/outputPath/scenes without building.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the build to be validated and queued (the build itself is polled via build status).

tools.name: build set_profile
tools.description: Edit an existing Build Profile's scene list and scripting defines (Unity 6 only). Every setting is optional; only the ones supplied change. The platform cannot be changed here: recreate the profile with build create_profile and confirm=true. Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the profile to edit (see build list_profiles).

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder holding the profile. Only needed when several profiles share the name.

parameters.name: overrideGlobalScenes
parameters.description: Build with the profile's own scene list instead of the global Build Settings list. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: scenes
parameters.description: Scene asset paths in build order, replacing the profile's scene list; all are enabled. An empty list clears it. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: scriptingDefines
parameters.description: Scripting define symbols replacing the profile's own. An empty list clears them. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Accepted for parity; not required, since the edit is undoable.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate the changes and report what would change, without writing anything.

tools.name: build set_settings
tools.description: Set mutable EditorUserBuildSettings fields. Does NOT manage scenes (use scene add_to_build / scene remove_from_build) or switch target (use build.target switch). Use dry_run to preview.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the changes. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

tools.name: build status
tools.description: Status of the current/most recent build: idle | queued | building | completed, with the full BuildReport (files, packedAssets, buildSteps, errors, warnings) once completed. Retained until the next build.

tools.name: build.target list
tools.description: List the known BuildTarget values with their group and whether build support is installed.

tools.name: build.target switch
tools.description: Switch the active build target (destructive, long-running: triggers a full reimport + domain reload). Requires confirm=true. Returns immediately; poll build.target switch_status.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: BuildTarget name to switch to (must be installed; see build.target list).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the switch. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the switch to be validated and queued (poll build.target switch_status).

tools.name: build.target switch_status
tools.description: Status of the last target switch: idle | switching | completed (with success + activeBuildTarget).

tools.name: capture game_view
tools.description: Capture the game view as a PNG. source=screen (default) captures what the Game window shows, incl. Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=camera renders a single camera instead and misses overlay UI. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in px (default 1280; capped 4096).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in px (default 720; capped 4096).

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Optional camera name (source=camera only); defaults to Camera.main, else the first enabled camera.

parameters.name: save_path
parameters.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

parameters.name: include_inline_image
parameters.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

parameters.name: max_resolution
parameters.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: What to capture: 'screen' (default) captures the game view's own render target — what the Game window shows, incl. Screen Space - Overlay UI (HUDs) in Play Mode; 'camera' renders a single camera off-screen instead and never sees overlay canvases. Defaults to 'camera' when a camera name is given.

tools.name: capture scene_view
tools.description: Render the active Scene View to a PNG. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in px (default 1280; capped 4096).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in px (default 720; capped 4096).

parameters.name: save_path
parameters.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

parameters.name: include_inline_image
parameters.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

parameters.name: max_resolution
parameters.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

tools.name: capture screenshot
tools.description: Capture the Scene or Game view as a PNG and return its file path

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Which view to capture: 'game' (default) or 'scene'

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output PNG path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to a timestamped file under <project>/Temp/pipeline-screenshots/.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current height.

tools.name: component add
tools.description: Add a component (by type name) to a GameObject.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the GameObject.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name (e.g. 'Rigidbody' or 'UnityEngine.Camera').

tools.name: component get_fields
tools.description: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path. Pass format='value' to return just the value(s) — a token-efficient read for scalars.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the component or asset to read (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional single SerializedProperty path to read (e.g. 'speed' or 'items.Array.data[0]'). Omit to read all top-level fields.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output shape. Omit (default) for a full descriptor per field {name,path,propertyType,isArray,arrayLength,value}; 'value' returns just the value(s): the raw value for a single 'field', or a {name: value} map for all fields.

tools.name: component get_properties
tools.description: Get a component's serialized properties as a JSON map. Address the component by handle, or by GameObject handle + type.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the component, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (omit when 'target' is a component handle).

tools.name: component remove
tools.description: Remove a component from a GameObject. Provide either a component handle (target) or a GameObject handle (target) plus a type name.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the component to remove, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name to remove from the target GameObject (omit when 'target' already points at a component).

tools.name: component set_field
tools.description: Set a serialized field on a component/asset. Supports primitives, enums, Vector/Color/Rect/Bounds, object references (value = an ObjectRef: asset by guid/fileId/path or scene object by instanceId/hierarchyPath), and array elements via 'name.Array.data[i]' (or 'name.Array.size' to resize).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the component or asset to modify (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: SerializedProperty path, e.g. 'speed', 'settings.speed', or 'waypoints.Array.data[0]'.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: JSON value to assign. For object references pass an ObjectRef object (or null to clear). For enums pass the value name.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

tools.name: component set_properties
tools.description: Set serialized properties on a component (one Undo step). 'properties' maps property name -> value; object references accept an ObjectRef handle.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Handle of the component, OR of the GameObject when 'type' is given.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Map of serialized property name to value. Vectors/colors are arrays; object refs are handle objects.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (omit when 'target' is a component handle).

tools.name: console clear
tools.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

tools.name: console get
tools.description: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)

parameters.name: tail

tools.name: job batch
tools.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; timeout (seconds, default 60) bounds execution — when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build run, build.target switch, the package commands, editor.playmode start/stop/pause, script recompile, script eval, script eval_file, script run, editor invoke_menu, scene open/scene create, async commands (test run/test list), runtime-only commands, and nested job batch.

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }, with command written as "<group> <name>" (e.g. "gameobject create"). Max 200.

parameters.name: transactional
parameters.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

parameters.name: on_error
parameters.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

parameters.name: result_fields
parameters.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for the whole batch in seconds (default 60). Checked before each op after the first; when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

tools.name: job wait
tools.description: Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll job wait_status for anything else.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition to wait for: { member, target?, findType?, op, value }. member is a dotted path (static, or instance under target/findType); op is equals|notEquals|greaterThan|lessThan|contains|changed.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30, clamped to 0-600). A sync wait reports timedOut slightly before it, so the reply lands first.

parameters.name: poll_interval_ms
parameters.description: How often to re-check the condition, in milliseconds (default 100, clamped to 16-5000; must be finite).

parameters.name: on_met
parameters.description: Follow-up run in the same editor frame the condition first holds: { capture: { view, source, save_path, width, height, include_image }, pause }.

parameters.name: return_history
parameters.description: Include the observed value/timestamp samples (a ring buffer of the last 200, so the tail near the transition is kept).

parameters.name: tolerate_missing
parameters.description: Treat resolution failures (type/member/instance not found) as condition-not-met and retry until timeout, instead of failing fast. Enables waiting for something to exist (e.g. a spawned object via findType).

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Return a wait_id immediately and evaluate in the background; poll job wait_status and cancel with job wait_cancel. Use this for long waits and whenever the condition depends on a command you still need to issue — a sync wait blocks it.

tools.name: job wait_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

parameters.name: wait_id
parameters.description: The wait id to cancel.

tools.name: job wait_status
tools.description: Get the status/result of an async wait started with job wait (async=true).

parameters.name: wait_id
parameters.description: The wait id returned by job wait when async=true.

parameters.name: additive
parameters.description: Open additively alongside currently open scenes instead of replacing them.

tools.name: scene remove_from_build

tools.name: scene save

parameters.name: path

tools.name: scene set_active

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of an already-open scene to make active (authoring-root relative; Assets/ prefix and .unity optional).

tools.name: script attach
tools.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then retry.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the GameObject to add the component to (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name to add, e.g. PlayerController or Game.Player.PlayerController. Must already be compiled. Mutually exclusive with 'script'.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Script asset path, e.g. 'Assets/Pool/Scripts/CueShooter.cs'. The backing class is resolved via MonoScript.GetClass(), so the class name may differ from the filename. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

tools.name: script create
tools.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then script attach.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

parameters.name: base_class
parameters.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

tools.name: script eval
tools.description: Evaluate C# code dynamically using Roslyn compiler

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: C# code to evaluate

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds

tools.name: script eval_file
tools.description: Evaluate C# code read from a .cs file on disk

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Path to a .cs file to evaluate

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds

tools.name: script recompile
tools.description: Force a script recompile (works while unfocused/minimized). Poll script recompile_status for completion.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: If true, bring the Editor to the foreground before compiling. Off by default.

tools.name: script recompile_status
tools.description: Get the status of the last recompile: idle | triggered | compiling | completed | up_to_date.

tools.name: script run
tools.description: Compile a project C# file in memory (no domain reload) and execute a named static entry point. The builder-pattern path for bulk construction. Still arbitrary code execution — shares script eval's capability gate.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Path to a .cs file to compile. Relative paths resolve against the PROJECT ROOT (the parent of Assets/), not the process working directory. May live OUTSIDE Assets/ (e.g. AgentScripts/) so writing it never triggers an asset import or domain reload.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Entry point as Namespace.Type.Method (or Type.Method, or a bare Method name). Default: the single public static method if unambiguous, else a method named Main. Static methods only in v1. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which never invokes an entry point).

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: JSON array of arguments passed to the entry point, coerced to its parameter types: primitives, enum names, string[], and a string/object handle (ObjectRef) for UnityEngine.Object parameters. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: ephemeral (default): compile to an in-memory assembly, run the entry, discard. hotpatch: apply [MethodReload] method replacements to already-loaded types (script.methodreload reload semantics).

parameters.name: references
parameters.description: Extra assembly name prefixes to reference beyond the auto-resolved set. In the Editor all loaded assemblies are already referenced, so this is effectively a no-op there. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch (which delegates to script.methodreload reload's own compile).

parameters.name: defines
parameters.description: Extra scripting define symbols APPENDED to the project's active editor defines (UNITY_EDITOR etc. are already set) for the compilation's #if directives. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch.

parameters.name: pdb
parameters.description: Emit a portable PDB mapped to the source file so breakpoints bind and exception stack traces map to file:line. Compiles unoptimized.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds. Bounds the whole run, including how long an async entry point's Task is awaited (on expiry the task keeps running detached).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Compile only: return diagnostics; the emitted assembly is NOT loaded into the domain and nothing executes. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which would apply live method replacements).

tools.name: script.methodreload cleanup
tools.description: Remove old method reload DLL versions and clear registry

parameters.name: assemblyDir
parameters.description: Directory containing assemblies to cleanup

parameters.name: force_domain_reload
parameters.description: Force Unity domain reload after cleanup

tools.name: script.methodreload generate_link_xml
tools.description: Generate ProjectSettings/Packages/com.unity.pipeline/MethodReload.link.xml: per-type preservation of the engine/package types the game's assemblies reference and of the game's own types, plus the interpreter's host surface and [MethodReload] targets. Applied to IL2CPP development builds only, while the Pipeline is enabled in development builds. Pass delete=true to remove the file instead.

parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Remove the generated file instead of (re)generating it.

tools.name: script.methodreload reload
tools.description: Compile and apply in-place [MethodReload] edits from a source file

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Source file containing [MethodReload] methods (e.g. Assets/Scripts/Player.cs)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Compilation timeout in seconds

parameters.name: assemblyDir
parameters.description: Directory to save compiled assemblies to disk (optional, default is in-memory only)

parameters.name: pdb
parameters.description: Emit debug symbols (portable PDB) mapped to the original source so breakpoints bind in your editor. Compiles unoptimized.

tools.name: script.methodreload reload_editor
tools.description: Compile in-place [MethodReload] edits and run them through the IlInterpreter VM in this process instead of Assembly.Load (IL2CPP-safe; only a minimal host API + the target type are available)

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Source file containing [MethodReload] methods (e.g. Assets/Scripts/Player.cs)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Compilation timeout in seconds

parameters.name: assemblyDir
parameters.description: Directory to save compiled assemblies to disk (optional, default is in-memory only)

parameters.name: pdb
parameters.description: Emit debug symbols (portable PDB) mapped to the original source so breakpoints bind in your editor. Compiles unoptimized.

tools.name: script.methodreload reload_player
tools.description: Compile a file's (or folder's) [MethodReload] method(s) and push the IL to a connected player (IL2CPP-safe) over PlayerConnection. Folders are walked recursively and pushed once.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Source .cs file or a folder containing [MethodReload] methods (e.g. Assets/pong.cs or Assets/Scripts)

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Target connected player id; -1 = broadcast to all connected players

tools.name: script.methodreload status
tools.description: Show current method reload registry status and statistics
